title: service-settings: the showcase boot fires the SettingsService "Pre-bind READ" diagnostic (namespace auth) — a reporter that never fires on a correct boot; find the early reader, do not demote the line
body:
Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) while routing #22160's remainder (retriage, `6056996366`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Reading

- **Measured by #22160's dev** (os-dev-report `6055648421`, H1 and `out_of_scope_findings[0]`): on `examples/app-showcase`, `os dev --seed-admin --fresh` at `7d7943dd`, one of the four boot records is the `[SettingsService]` **Pre-bind READ** warning (namespace `auth`), logged at `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts` (about `:774`, `reportPreBindRead`).
- **What that reporter means, from its own docblock:** the engine bind is ordered before any read (ADR-0116), so "on a correct boot this reporter never fires" (`settings-prebind-read-warning.test.ts`). The window check is `pnpm check:settings-bind-window`.
- So the line is a real boot-order signal on the showcase: something reads the `auth` namespace before the engine bind. It is not an expected degradation.
- **History:** #13256 (closed 2026-08-30) fixed the same class on the quickstart. This is the class firing again on the showcase.

## Done when

- The early reader is found and moved after the bind, or the bind is ordered before it. The showcase boot then logs no Pre-bind READ.
- **⛔ Not a level change.** The maintainer's noise budget on #22160 sends expected degradations to `info`. This line is a defect signal, so it keeps `warn`, and the fix removes its cause.
- **Pin:** a showcase-shaped boot asserts that no Pre-bind READ is reported. Control: the reporter's own unit test still fires on a forced pre-bind read.

## Not this card

- The showcase's `[sharing-rule] … expands to NO recipients` line is objectstack-ai/objectstack#15086's root cause (unstamped business-unit seed rows; v18, ADR-0131). It is not a level change either.
- The banner's deployment-policy Flows lines are #22255.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` 「showcase boot SettingsService pre-bind read warning sharing-rule business unit expands to no recipients」 gave 9 hits. #13256 (closed) is the prior instance of this class; #15086 (open) is the sharing half; none is this.

Dedupe words: SettingsService Pre-bind READ showcase · pre-bind read namespace auth · settings bind window showcase boot
